$comment: Official Remotion starter templates, fetched at the pinned commit into .cache/<name> by fetch.ts (never vendored). stills: composition id to frames rendered at scale 1 by Remotion (tools/oracle-render/record-templates.ts) and by Motio (packages/cli/src/templates.integration.test.ts). network: the template loads fonts from the internet while rendering. gl: chromiumOptions.gl Remotion records with (WebGL templates use swangle, the software renderer Motio uses by default). blockedBy: Motio symbols the template needs that are not implemented yet; the Motio test expects the build to fail until they land. knownMismatch: "<composition>/<frame>" to the reason that still does not match yet; the Motio test expects it to miss the thresholds until the cause is fixed. unsupported: the template imports Remotion packages Motio does not provide; the Motio test expects the compat plugin's build error naming one of them.
